name: Weary
overview: Scripture reveals that weariness is a common human experience, yet the everlasting God never grows tired or weary and offers strength to the faint and powerless. Those who wait on the LORD will have their strength renewed, enabling them to continue without fainting. God promises to satisfy the weary soul and grant rest to those burdened, encouraging believers not to grow weary in doing good, for in due time, they will reap a harvest if they do not give up.
